commands.name: FailSlaReportAttempt
steps: validate failure_code against FailSlaReportAttemptRequestV1 outside the writer lock; never accept a filesystem path, candidate filename or cleanup target from the failure caller

inside one bounded UoW resolve command receipt first: exact committed command_id/command_type/request_hash replay returns the original ReportAttemptV1 before current state/revision checks; any mismatch is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
revalidate exact expected revision and require state in staging|ready_to_generate|generating|verifying; completed, failed and cancelled attempts are not mutable failure targets
if state=verifying, capture the persisted bounded unverified candidate filename for post-commit housekeeping only; never derive a cleanup target from request data
insert one command receipt before last_command_id reference
delete only this attempt's non-authoritative staging children in FK-safe order: sla_report_member_tier_results, sla_report_member_snapshots, sla_report_cohort_snapshots, report_section_snapshots

zero all staged counts; clear snapshot_hash, artifact_filename, artifact_sha256, artifact_size_bytes and verified_at_utc; set state=failed, bounded failure_code, completed_at_utc=server-now, increment revision/set last_command_id; append exactly one sla.report.cancelled_or_failed.v1 audit and construct ReportAttemptV1

commit receipt, complete staging cleanup, failed state/revision and audit atomically; after commit, best-effort remove only the captured sibling temporary candidate through the filesystem adapter resolved from the existing validated job destination context
rules: the worker/orchestrator assigns one UUID command_id to this exact failure transition before first invocation and reuses it on every retry
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 binds report_attempt_id, expected revision and failure_code; exact committed replay cannot delete rows, advance revision or audit twice
failure cleanup never deletes completed report evidence, a final published artifact, unrelated files, operational records, classification, policy or contributor authority
a rollback removes the receipt, every staging-child deletion, cleared metadata, failed transition and audit together; a failed attempt can never commit with a partial staged population
temporary-candidate cleanup failure is diagnostic housekeeping only and cannot roll back or alter the committed failed state

commands.name: CancelSlaReportAttempt
steps: request durable job cancellation at a safe boundary

once worker is outside artifact finalization/completed transition, inside UoW insert receipt/delete all non-authoritative staged SLA and registered-section children/set counters zero/state cancelled/completed_at/revision/audit/commit
clean temporary artifact best-effort outside transaction
rules: cancellation creates no completed evidence and no operational cleanup
